issue.title: bob capture -X on one of two ID-less dependents panics: tracked task headline is not a task (task_blocks.rs:587)

task_type_fields.impact: Canceling one of two ID-less successor offers in one note (`-X`, or the Obsidian/Mac Cancel verdict that maps to it) crashes every debug build and test. In release builds it silently skips the tracked task's block handling, so a Cancel Log or block move can be dropped or misplaced. It also blocks writing a JS4-style jump vector for ID-less rows.
task_type_fields.repro:
Found by the bob-cli-oe land agent while verifying bob-cli-oe.1 (the reviewer's probe, independently reproduced on bob-cli master 8f703ccb with a debug build).

1. Use a scratch vault with the Tasks plugin global filter `#task`, statuses ` `, `x`, `*`, `?`, `/`, `-`, a `sase.md` holding `- [ ] #task Bar [id:: bar] ^bar`, and a daily note `20261005.md` whose `## Pomodoros` has an open entry linking `[[sase#^bar]]`.
2. Write `deps.md` with two ID-less Blocked dependents:
   ```
   - [?] #task Alpha [dependsOn:: bar]
   - [?] #task Beta [dependsOn:: bar]
   ```
3. Run `BOB_DAY_FILE=<vault>/20261005.md BOB_NOW="2026-10-05 09:30:00" target/debug/bob capture -b <vault> -f json -X 1=why -- '!sase:bar'`.

Result: the debug build panics with `thread 'main' panicked at src/native/capture/task_blocks.rs:587:21: tracked task headline is not a task`, and the vault is unchanged. Without `-j` it reproduces the same way, so it is not from the jump-offer work. The code is `debug_assert!(false, ...)` followed by `continue` in the tracked-task loop (blame 00d49417e). The offer-close (`-X`) writer that triggers it arrived with efbe3470. In release builds the assert is compiled out, so that tracked task block is skipped silently.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-oe land review hit this debug_assert while probing the jump-offer contract. It reproduces without -j, predates the epic, and blocks ID-less offer-close vectors.

payload.description: Found during the bob-cli-oe landing review; the epic's JS4-style vectors for ID-less rows are blocked by this panic
